_comment: Tool pages from which a person cannot reach a real claim by following links in the page's own
content. They offer a calculation and, at most, a link to another calculation. Somebody arrives
believing they are owed money and leaves holding arithmetic.
Scoped to <main> on purpose: the header and footer link to /money from every page, and counting
those would make every page look like it offers a way forward.
This list is a ratchet and may only shrink. scripts/routeSweep.mjs fails when a route appears
that is not listed here, and fails again when a listed route has since been given a way forward
and the line was not deleted. Adding a route here is a decision to leave it broken for now, not
a way to silence the check.
Tool count is not an asset. docs/INFRASTRUCTURE_DOCTRINE.md calls tool sprawl an anti-pattern,
so deleting a page is as valid a fix as wiring one.
WHAT THIS NUMBER DOES NOT SEE (2026-08-12, extended 2026-08-14). The check reads
each page as it loads — it never fills a form or presses a button, so any next
step that only renders after interaction is invisible to it by construction, not
because it is missing. /advance-tax shows gov.il form 2216א after the letter is
drafted, /scam-check offers /duplicate-charge once a message is pasted,
/school-payments links the Ministry of Education circular for a charge that
is actually mandatory. /miluim, /maternity and /unemployment name the
Bituach Leumi forms (בל/501, בל/502, the 3010 certificate) in a promoted
next-step block.
2026-08-14: read every remaining route's source, not just its rendered HTML, to
check the same claim for the other eleven. All eleven already have a real,
conditionally-rendered next step:
/deadlines links to /commitments (a fix already shipped, this line is what is
stale, not the page). /dormant, /incident and /vehicle-check each end in a
per-item letter generator with copy/print once past their isIsraeli gate.
/complaint-escalation and /overtime-backpay render <NextStep> once a letter is
generated. /entitlements links every matched item outward and offers /signup and
/rights once results exist. /cancel/universal gives every detected subscription a send/copy/
agent-send letter. /score (behind a client-side hydration gate the crawler's
600ms read cannot always outlast) is the richest of all of them — a per-gap
<ClaimDocument> that expands into a real letter, plus NextActionCard and
CaptiveCard. /assistant surfaces the user's actual next action (a pending fee, a
proposed saving, an exhausted follow-up) above the chat, for anyone who already
has a case. /holocaust-survivors is deliberately not agentic — see the page's own
comment on why opening a Case here is the wrong shape of help — but still ends in
a CTA linking to /assistant and /entitlements, which is its real next step.
So every route on this list has a verified real next step today. The list is not
empty because the check that enforces it cannot see any of them — closing that
gap means teaching routeSweep.mjs to interact (fill the minimum required field,
press generate) before it reads <main>, which has not been done. Until it is, do
not read this list as seventeen broken pages, and do not bolt an internal link
onto a page whose correct answer is a government form, or a letter that already
exists one click below the fold, just to make a count move.
